body.heading: Where in the world is Jordan?
paragraphs: Jordan is a country in Western Asia, which is part of Asia.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Jordan is Amman.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Jordan is Arabic.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Jordan is the Jordanian dinar.

body.heading: How big is Jordan?
paragraphs: Jordan covers about 89,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Cambodia.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Walk through a narrow rock canyon called the Siq and Petra's Treasury bursts into view — a palace facade carved into rose-red cliffs by the Nabataeans 2,000 years ago.
Wadi Rum is a valley of red sand and towering rock mountains where families ride jeeps and camels and sleep in Bedouin camps under blazing stars.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Jordan on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?

takeaway: Jordan in one breath: a country in Western Asia, capital Amman, where people speak Arabic and pay with the Jordanian dinar.
